decision.reason: The bounded stage needs a schema-constrained answer, not an executable tool request. Two prompt-only json_object validations drifted in shape and two DeepSeek strict named-function validations produced no closed v4 output or Agent artifact. A provider-native JSON Schema response channel is a materially different transport and preserves fail-closed local validation without a third same-route attempt.

official_capability_basis.title: Structured model outputs
official_capability_basis.observed_contract: Responses Structured Outputs supports json_schema through text.format with strict true, distinguishes structured assistant responses from function calling, and exposes refusal and incomplete response states for typed handling.

official_capability_basis.title: GPT-5.6 Sol model
official_capability_basis.observed_contract: The current model catalog identifies Responses and Structured Outputs support; exact model choice remains intentionally unfrozen in this decision.

official_capability_basis.title: JSON Output
official_capability_basis.observed_contract: json_object guarantees valid JSON strings rather than conformance to the project's exact v4 schema and may return empty content.

official_capability_basis.title: Tool Calls strict mode
official_capability_basis.observed_contract: DeepSeek schema-constrained strict mode remains a beta tool-call path, which is the already-consumed route being retired from further T03 live validation.

rejected_options.reason: It repeats the consumed route after two attempts without a closed v4 output or Agent artifact and violates the frozen stop rule.
It is weaker than exact JSON Schema conformance and the project already observed two first-stage shape failures on that family.
It would hide transport nonconformance and risks changing financial-research semantics rather than proving the exact contract.
No adapter, exact model binding, credential gate, cost envelope, admission, or execution authority exists yet.

required_proof_sequence: implement one provider-neutral native-json-schema response adapter behind the existing bounded executor boundary
prove request translation and refusal incomplete cardinality parse and semantic failures with deterministic fixtures and zero provider calls
perform an independent contract review and retain the existing canonical terminal failure truth path
only after a separate user decision bind an exact provider model credential environment budget case input and fresh execution identity in a new admission
only after another explicit execution instruction consume that admission once and stop on success or failure
